placements.role: Provides outsourced advanced packaging, including chiplet and heterogeneous-integration technologies.

role_evidence.claim: JCET's annual-results release identifies the listed company as an integrated-circuit back-end manufacturing and technology provider and says it converted high-end technology breakthroughs into mass-production capability.

business_summary: Jiangsu Changjiang Electronics Technology Co., Ltd., trading as JCET, is an SSE-listed outsourced semiconductor assembly and test provider and the largest such business in China. Its own annual-results release describes it as an integrated-circuit back-end manufacturing and technology provider, which is the same economic role as Amkor and ASE on the advanced-packaging link.

exposure_summary.narrative: One ACTIVE placement, on advanced-packaging (position 7, CHOKE_POINT, heat EMERGING), VERIFIED from JCET's own 2025 annual-results release, which says it converted high-end technology breakthroughs into mass-production capability. It is the China-domiciled comparable on the same link as Amkor and ASE, and carries an export-control exposure neither of those two does.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: JCET reports consolidated revenue without an AI or advanced-packaging split, and no percentage attributable to this chain was read from a primary JCET source this run.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 38,871,348,331 CNY from the yfinance-statements statements in 600584-SS.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (38,871,348,331/33,762,028,449)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 2,091,506,751 CNY divided by revenue 38,871,348,331 CNY, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 4,652,212,168 CNY divided by net income 1,565,238,036 CNY, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 4,652,212,168 CNY less capex 6,298,299,227 CNY, divided by revenue 38,871,348,331 CNY, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 6,850,225,026 CNY (total debt 12,425,180,582 less cash 5,574,955,556, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 6,216,956,047 CNY (operating income 2,091,506,751 plus depreciation 4,125,449,296 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 6 (state MIDDLING) computed over yfinance-statements statements in 600584-SS.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.675 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in 600584-SS.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 134,080,833,730 CNY computed in 600584-SS.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 134,080,833,730 CNY divided by revenue 38,871,348,331 CNY for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: reverse-DCF implied FCF CAGR: quality.reverse_dcf.state is NOT_APPLICABLE for JCET, reason 'base-year free cash flow is not positive; a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless'; the solver correctly declines to run rather than producing a meaningless growth rate.

horizon_spread.basis: reverse-DCF horizon spread: not available for JCET for the same NOT_APPLICABLE reason as implied_fcf_cagr ('base-year free cash flow is not positive; a growth rate on a negative base is meaningless').

crowdedness_caveats: The advanced-packaging link's heat verdict is EMERGING with crowdedness 55, the least crowded link this batch touches (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json).
No price, no 52-week range, no coverage reading and no ownership reading exist for this listing on disk, so crowdedness could not be measured for it at all.
A China-domiciled listing on a link defined by leading-edge Western accelerator supply is structurally different from its Taiwanese and US peers, whatever the coverage numbers would say.
No valuation multiple is computed anywhere on this profile, so this file contains no basis for a priced-in judgement.
